prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the left, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped from early fatigue. Beside her, a spotted cat rests calmly, its tail curled neatly around its paws. In the center, a young boy in a yellow cap stands holding a woven basket, his gaze fixed intently on the produce before him. To his right, a farmer in green overalls points toward a pile of fresh apples, directing attention to their quality. Next to the farmer, a brown dog sits patiently, waiting for a stray morsel. The old woman hands a small coin to the boy, completing a simple transaction. The farmer looks at the dog, acknowledging its presence near the stall. There is no modern technology visible in this timeless setting. The soft lines and faint hues emphasize the tranquil atmosphere of the morning hour without overwhelming the delicate structural details of the figures and their surroundings.
